lyrics:
[Intro: soft synth pad, a single piano note repeating]

[Verse 1: raspy female voice, almost whispered]
I tell people that we drifted
I say nobody was to blame
I say it kindly at a party
With a drink, and without shame

[Pre-Chorus: drums approaching, voice tightening]
That isn't how it went
You know it, and I do

[Chorus: explosive, full band, voice belting]
I was the weather
I came through every room
Every door I slammed, every plate, every word
You just lived there, I was the storm
I was the weather
And you were just trying to stay warm

[Verse 2: whispered again, piano and pad]
You'd check my face when I came home
To see what kind of night it was
I thought that you were being careful
I never asked myself the cause

[Pre-Chorus: drums approaching]
I called it passion, called it honest
It was only loud

[Chorus: explosive, full band, voice belting]
I was the weather
I came through every room
Every door I slammed, every plate, every word
You just lived there, I was the storm
I was the weather
And you were just trying to stay warm

[Bridge: band drops out, voice bare]
I'm not asking you back
I'm not asking for a thing
I just needed you to hear me say it
It was me

[Final Chorus: full, voice cracking, last line quiet]
I was the weather
I came through every room
Every door I slammed, every plate, every word
You just lived there, I was the storm
I was the weather
I hope it's quiet where you are

[Outro: piano note repeating, rain stopping]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 60 BPM, 4/4, D minor verses and F major choruses. Very slow, with the largest possible contrast between verse and chorus.

VOICE: Female, low and raspy with a country edge. The verses are close and whispered. The choruses are full-throated belts with a crack on the top notes. The bridge is bare and unaccompanied in places. She ends quietly.

INSTRUMENTS: A soft synth pad, piano, a huge, compressed drum kit that enters only in the choruses, distorted synth bass, a wall of strings and guitars in the choruses, a single repeating piano note.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:42 Pre-chorus. 0:52 Chorus 1. 1:24 Verse 2. 1:56 Pre-chorus. 2:06 Chorus 2. 2:38 Bridge, bare. 3:00 Final chorus. 3:30 Outro, one note and rain stopping, ends 3:40.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2013 pop power ballad: tiny, dry verses and huge, wide, crushing choruses.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first chorus hitting at 0:52.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original is a young woman in the rubble the next morning. This is a woman ten years later who has finally stopped telling the polite version.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Evasive, confessing, bare, wishing him peace.
